column1: # Manual IGDB matches for ES-DE ROMs, applied by match_roms.py on every run.
# Use it when a ROM matched the wrong IGDB game, or none (the ROM page shows
# the system, the ROM path and the current IGDB id).
# system: ES-DE folder (snesna, gb, …); rom_path: as in the gamelist, e.g.
# ./Variants/Zombies (Europe).zip; igdb_id: from the game's IGDB page
# (igdb.com → the game → "IGDB ID" in the sidebar). note is free text.
# Keep your own copy at ~/.config/game-catalog/rom-igdb-pins.tsv (the scripts read
# that one when it exists); this repo copy is only the empty template.
